title: phegopteris levingei
intro: Phegopteris levingei, commonly known as the Himalayan chain fern, is a species of fern that belongs to the family Thelypteridaceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive problems, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Phegopteris levingei include anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and antimicrobial properties, which help to reduce pain, lower fever, and prevent infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
